title: Sheaves with a left exact reflector inherit Grothendieckness
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$ [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $C$ be a $\mathcal U$-small category with a Grothendieck topology $J$, and let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category relative to $\mathcal U$, with $\mathcal U$-small morphism sets [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. Write $\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\mathcal A)$ for the full category of functors $C^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathcal A$ for which $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal A}(T,F(-))$ is a sheaf of sets for every $T\in\mathcal A$. Suppose the inclusion into presheaves has a left adjoint which preserves finite limits (left exact sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]). Then $\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\mathcal A)$ is Grothendieck abelian. In particular $\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\mathrm{Ab}_{\mathcal U})$ is Grothendieck abelian, with no extra assumption on $J$.
